gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o2 -> i4: // Unstable assertion: assertEquals(0, soundex0.getMaxLength());
ADDED i2: Non-letter characters are stripped before encoding; H and W are silent in US_ENGLISH
ADDED i3: Encoding a null string returns null without throwing an exception
ADDED i5: A mapping shorter than 26 chars causes IllegalArgumentException when a letter falls outside the mapping range
ADDED i8: encode(Object) only accepts String; passing any other type throws EncoderException
ADDED i10: encode(Object) delegates to encode(String); letters extracted from the input are encoded via the custom mapping
ADDED i11: difference() scores phonetic similarity on a 0–4 scale; 1 indicates little similarity
ADDED i12: The US_ENGLISH_GENEALOGY mapping string "-123-12--22455-12623-1-2-2" is a valid 26-char mapping
ADDED i13: A char array containing a single SILENT_MARKER ('-') is accepted as a mapping
ADDED i14: Two identical strings produce the same Soundex code; difference() between them is 0
ADDED i15: setMaxLength() on the static US_ENGLISH instance does not affect a separately constructed instance
ADDED i16: The default constructor always initialises maxLength to 4 (Soundex codes are exactly 4 characters)
ADDED i17: The (String, boolean) constructor with specialCaseHW=false still defaults maxLength to 4
